title: Browns fans cheer Deshaun Watson's late go-ahead TD throw that leads comeback win over Panthers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns fans cheer Deshaun Watson's late go-ahead TD throw that leads comeback win over Panthers
sources.description: A fan base that's weary of losing and was infuriated in the preseason by Watson earning the starting job appears to have now embraced its embattled quarterback amid a 2-1 start.
